0022600035.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 12th in the East) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, 15th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A regular-season game, with Orlando on a one-game winning streak but still 0-4 at home, while Milwaukee has lost seven straight and is 0-5 on the road. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jamal Cain, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero, and Tristan da Silva, and Milwaukee is without Myles Turner (rest). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Magic won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 130-91 win in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
